documents.title: Intimation Regarding Issuance And Allotment Of Commercial Paper Amounting To Rs. 150 Crores
Board Meeting Intimation for Notice Of Board Meeting
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Intimation of Repayment of Commercial Paper (CP)
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with consolidated revenue of INR 1,432 crores and EBITDA of INR 313 crores. Management highlighted strategic expansions including a new Carbon Nanotube facility and Super Speciality Carbon Black capacity conversion. The company also progressed on its battery materials initiatives, including commissioning an anode material facility and advancing LFP cathode capacity plans. Furthermore, management noted that the Birla Tyres turnaround continues with modernization efforts and plans for future product segments. Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, delivering consolidated revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach INR 3,000 crores of top line in Birla Tyres in the next 4 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: We will continue this trajectory and in next 4 years to 5 years the target is to reach INR3,000 Crores of top line in Birla tyres.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve top-line and bottom-line growth in the current year.
guidance.quote: For the current year, we don't prefer to give any specific number guideline, but on a macro basis, I can give you guideline that current year we will see both top line and bottom-line growth.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR 3,000 crores of top line from the Birla Tyres business in the next 4 years.
guidance.quote: Birla Tyres top line contribution for this year was INR 187 crores, and we expect to be around INR 3,000 crores of top line from this business in next 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company committed to double its FY25 PAT of INR 555 crores in the next three years to INR 1,100 plus crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: See, again, coming to that, I have given a guidance that FY25 we had a PAT of INR 555 crores. We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from approximately 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer engagements for LFP cathode active materials have intensified significantly with leading Indian and global cell manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer engagements have intensified significantly with leading Indian as well as global cell manufacturers, and the response has been strongly encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility is backed by a planned capex of approximately INR 70 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity to Super Speciality Carbon Black with a capex of INR 170 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We are converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR170 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA capacity for LFP cathode chemistry is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27 as the first milestone under Phase 1 of a 40,000 MTPA expansion plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The total announced capex is around INR 2,000 Crores, consisting of INR 1,125 Crores for LFP, INR 368 Crores announced yesterday, and INR 500 Crores of capex this year in Birla Tyres.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, total capex we have announced is around INR2,000 Crores, INR1,125 Crores for LFP, INR368 Crores announced yesterday. So that brings to around INR1,500 Crores of capex, plus INR500 Crores of capex this year in Birla Tyres. So total INR2,000 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Speciality Chemicals Anthraquinone and Carbazole have Phase 1 capex of 2,600 MTPA capacity and Phase 2 capex of 2,700 MTPA capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Speciality Chemicals: Anthraquinone + Carbazole Phase 1 capex of 2,600 MTPA capacity Commissioning Q2FY27 Phase 2 capex of 2,700 MTPA capacity Q2FY28

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd April 2026, we successfully commissioned operation at our first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry, West Bengal with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum, marking a pivotal step in our entry into lithium-ion battery materials value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project envisages a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Execution of Phase 1 of our lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project, which envisages a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum is on track.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry, taking our total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum and our overall carbon black capacity to 250,000 metric ton per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 28% year-on-year, EBITDA increased by 33%, and profit after tax jumped by 27%.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,432 Crores as compared to INR1,118 Crores a year ago, an increase of 28%. Our EBITDA stood at INR313 Crores as compared to INR235 Crores a year ago with an increase of 33% and margin of 22%. Our profit after tax has significantly increased to INR228 Crores from INR179 Crores a year ago, a jump of 27% with a margin of 16%.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR 1,274 Crores with an EBITDA margin of 24%.
margins_costs.quote: Our stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,274 Crores as compared to INR1,100 Crores a year ago, an increase of 16%. Our EBITDA stood at INR301 Crores as compared to INR234 Crores a year ago with a growth rate of 29% and margin of 24%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company's resilient business model allows it to pass on increases in input prices to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So whether it is crude-based or coal tar-based, whatever increase in price is there, we transfer to our customers. So that has helped us to build up a resilient business model.

margins_costs.claim: The average EBITDA per metric ton for the entire portfolio was around INR 17,000.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA in terms of if you look at our EBITDA per metric ton, it was around INR17,000 per metric ton on an average on the entire basket of portfolio.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion is a sustainable long-term improvement driven by operational efficiencies, yield improvements, and waste recovery systems.
margins_costs.quote: See, the margins expansion that you are seeing is not one-off thing. It's a sustainable long-term margin improvement that, because of our all efforts in terms of improvement in yield, operational efficiencies, waste recovery systems we have been able to do, and these are sustainable on a long-term basis, and will strengthen further only.

orders_capacity.claim: The company commissioned a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry in April 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: On the anode side, we have commissioned our 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry in April 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total capacity of 250,000 metric tons in speciality carbon black, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity across more than 70 speciality grades.
orders_capacity.quote: With 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity, we operate across a product portfolio of more than 70 speciality grades.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a coal tar distillation capacity of 600,000 MTPA with a domestic market share of over 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We operate the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex, with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity. Our domestic market share continues to be over 65%

orders_capacity.claim: Himadri operates 8 zero discharge plants across India and China.
orders_capacity.quote: 8 zero discharge plants across India & China

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds a 65% domestic market share in coal tar pitch.
Coal tar distillation capacity is 600,000 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The anode material facility at Mahistikry has a capacity of 200 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Established a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry, West Bengal

orders_capacity.claim: Coal-tar pitch distillation capacity was successfully debottlenecked to take it to 600,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: With the successful de-bottling of our coal-tar pitch distillation capacity, taking it to 600,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects around 85%-90% capacity utilization for newly announced capacities for FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We expect to have around 85%-90% capacity utilization for our newly announced capacities for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: As of 31st March 2026, the company holds a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March 2026, we hold a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores, which gives us ample flexibilities to pursue growth opportunities while maintaining a prudent approach to capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed reached 32% in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our return on capital employed has also shown a steady upward trajectory, reaching 32% in FY26, a testament to our sharp focus on value creation and capital efficiencies.

capital_allocation.claim: The total capex incurred for the 40,000 metric ton cathode facility is INR 1,125 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that currency volatility led to forex losses during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is no change in the hedging policy because of the huge volatility in the currency, this happened.

risks_headwinds.claim: Recent geopolitical developments in West Asia have introduced volatility in energy prices and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: Turning to the operating environment, recent geopolitical developments in West Asia have introduced volatility in energy prices and logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is not dependent on West Asia for core feedstock or operations, keeping the business structurally insulated.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, our business remains structurally insulated as we are not dependent on that region for our core feedstock or operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sharp depreciation in the rupee and huge volatility impacted the company on the import side and led to hedging losses.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you know, there was sharp depreciation in rupees which impacted us on the import side. And export side also, we hedged something, but generally we keep our position open. Because of this huge volatility, we hedged. Because of the hedging, we had to incur losses this time.

management_commitments.claim: The 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility is targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

management_commitments.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA LFP capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28, paving the way for its planned entry into EV and SUV tyre segments.

management_commitments.claim: The Carbon Nano Tube commercial plant is scheduled for commissioning in Q4FY27.
Super Speciality Carbon Black is scheduled for commissioning in Q4FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Super Speciality Carbon Black Commissioning Q4FY28

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 capex of 2,600 MTPA capacity for Anthraquinone is to be commissioned in Q2FY27.
Phase 2 capex of 2,700 MTPA capacity for Anthraquinone and Carbazole is to be completed by Q2FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2 capex of 2,700 MTPA capacity Q2FY28

management_commitments.claim: Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility commissioning for Birla Tyres is targeted by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: PCR facility commissioning targeted by FY28

management_commitments.claim: The first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons of LFP cathode active material is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: FY29 is envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations of the LFP cathode active material project.
management_commitments.quote: The balance Phase 1 capacity will be progressively brought onstream over the subsequent 12 months, closely aligned with customer approvals and demand visibility, with FY29 envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations.

management_commitments.claim: Sicona's capacity expansion is currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: During the year, Sicona has achieved important milestones at pilot scale level, with further capacity expansion currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, supporting intensified engagement with global cell manufacturers across multiple stages of sample approvals.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next 12 to 24 months, the company will progressively enhance capacity utilization for Birla Tyres.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 12 to 24 months, we will be progressively enhance our capacity utilization, supported by robust pipeline of new product launches across agriculture, mining and commercial vehicle segments.

management_commitments.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

management_commitments.claim: By FY28, the company expects the new commissioning capacity of 100,000 tons, yielding 50,000 tons of coal tar pitch to be completely exported to the global market.
management_commitments.quote: See, by FY28, we expect the new commissioning capacity of 100,000 tons, which gives us 50,000 tons of coal tar pitch that will be completely exported to the global market.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
